message:
## Vulnerability Digest

This DLL component scan used only `DLL_software_component.txt`; obvious aliases and duplicate entries were normalized within that file. `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined. The scan window was **2026-10-03 13:10 IST through 2026-10-04 13:10 IST** (2026-10-03 07:40 through 2026-10-04 07:40 UTC).

**No credible, newly reported vulnerabilities were found that both fall within the exact 24-hour window and confidently match the monitored DLL/component scope.**

### Candidate review

The newly discussed Bouncy Castle disclosures were checked closely because `BouncyCastle.Crypto` 1.8.1 is in the assigned inventory. The .NET (`bc-csharp`) CVE batch affects versions before 2.7.0, but its CVE records were published on October 2, before this run's cutoff, so it was excluded as stale for this digest. Separate Bouncy Castle findings published October 3 apply to BC-JAVA, not the listed .NET DLL, and were excluded as a product mismatch.

No other fresh NuGet, npm, vendor, or commercial-SDK advisory found in the window could be matched confidently to an assigned component and listed version.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes operators, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector/SQL Interface, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, MongoDB-owned security alerts, CVE/NVD-oriented records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA-oriented reporting.

No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported within the exact 24-hour window. The most recent MongoDB-related advisories encountered predated the cutoff and were excluded.

### Sources checked

- [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories)
- [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)
- [MongoDB Compass release notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/release-notes/)
- [Bouncy Castle C# .NET 2.7.0 release notice](https://www.bouncycastle.org/resources/new-release-bouncy-castle-c-2-7-0/)
- Vendor security and release channels for the monitored component families

### Review priority

No immediate review is recommended based solely on vulnerabilities newly reported in this 24-hour window. The older Bouncy Castle .NET batch remains operationally relevant to the listed 1.8.1 component, but it is outside this digest's freshness window and should be handled through the existing vulnerability backlog rather than reported as new.
